games.name: Junction Nine
games.core: Traffic phase coordination with incompatible movements, changing arrivals and queue spillback.
games.distinction: Control competing queues across time rather than navigate hazards.
games.newDistinction: Traffic selects mutually exclusive service phases for stationary competing queues; elevator instead routes one capacity-limited carrier between floors.

games.name: Assembly Belt
games.core: Live conveyor processing with ordered transformations, limited machine energy and rejection handling.
games.distinction: Operate a moving production pipeline rather than prewrite a robot route.
games.newDistinction: Assembly changes the transformation of individual moving workpieces at physical pipeline stages; Supply Web invests in aggregate capacity along a resource DAG.

games.name: Marsh Balance
games.core: Delayed coupled predator–prey population control with habitat regeneration.
games.distinction: Population feedback and lag rather than individual plant maturity.
games.newDistinction: Ecology couples delayed births, feeding and regeneration; urban zoning changes migration through persistent spatial externalities and taxes.

games.name: Reorder Point
games.core: Inventory lot sizing with shipping lead time, holding costs and lost demand.
games.distinction: Fulfill demand through a delayed pipeline rather than time resale prices.
games.newDistinction: Reordering chooses lot sizes before transport delay; Cold Chain handles ingredient expiration, refrigeration dwell and recipe composition after receipt.

games.name: Workshop Shift
games.core: Worker placement with exclusive stations, shift resets and multi-resource recipes.
games.distinction: Allocate a limited worker set across occupied stations each shift.
games.newDistinction: Workshop assigns a finite crew to stations that become occupied until the shift ends; Supply Web permanently invests in throughput capacity that runs every tick.

games.name: Signal Cabinet
games.core: Online priority scheduling with setup costs, released jobs and completion deadlines.
games.distinction: Single processor with dynamic arrivals and setup classes, not a prerequisite graph.
games.newDistinction: Signal Cabinet preempts jobs on one processor with expensive tool-class switches; Borrowed Time uses simultaneous non-preemptible crews on a prerequisite DAG.

games.name: Cold Chain
games.core: Perishable batch processing with parallel aging, cooling capacity and recipe orders.
games.distinction: Batch composition and expiry across processing stages.
games.newDistinction: Cold Chain chooses refrigeration and cooking actions over individually aging ingredients; Reorder Point controls procurement quantities in a two-day shipping pipeline.

games.name: Reservoir
games.core: Forecast-driven release control under storage, flood and demand constraints.
games.distinction: Time-varying external inflows and demand, not conservation in jugs.
games.newDistinction: Reservoir directly releases one stock under external flow forecasts; Kiln House must control two thermally coupled lagging states and dwell before cooling.

games.name: Power Desk
games.core: Unit commitment with startup delays, ramping, fuel and battery dispatch.
games.distinction: Discrete plant startup and dispatch constraints.
games.newDistinction: Power Desk schedules a discrete startup and ramp-limited turbine plus bounded battery dispatch; Reservoir directly chooses a water release without startup or ramping.

games.name: Carry On
games.core: Sequential multidimensional knapsack with irreversible decisions and a single exchange.
games.distinction: Online acceptance and replacement, rather than a fixed shopping combination.
games.newDistinction: Carry On commits sequentially under two packing constraints and limited exchange, with incomplete previews; Convoy allocates reusable escorts simultaneously against fully visible route threats.

games.name: Quiet Majority
games.core: Weighted coalition planning with permanent policy concessions, temporary grants and changing public approval thresholds.
games.distinction: Choose binding policy concessions satisfying conflicting factions, no territory draft.
games.newDistinction: Council commits policies with positive and negative faction preferences and temporary grants to meet vote thresholds; Workshop allocates workers to production stations and material recipes.

games.name: Safe Return
games.core: Collateral-constrained underwriting with overlapping policy durations, correlated claims and changing future quotes.
games.distinction: Commit collateral across different policy lifetimes while correlated claims and future quotes compete for capital.
games.newDistinction: Outstanding liabilities lock reusable capital across days; Carry On instead accumulates fixed expedition items.

games.name: Firebreak
games.core: Dynamic fire-front containment using persistent trenches and limited water.
games.distinction: Defend valuable cells against an evolving frontier rather than grow a region.
games.newDistinction: Firebreak modifies a spatial propagation frontier and reacts to scheduled ignitions; Marsh Balance regulates numerical populations through coupled food-web feedback.

games.name: Kiln House
games.core: Coupled thermal inertia control with temperature dwell and gradient stress.
games.distinction: Two delayed thermal states and material stress, not a scalar stock.
games.newDistinction: Kiln House must manage conduction lag, temperature gradient stress, dwell and final cooldown; Power Desk matches electrical supply using startup and ramp constraints.

games.name: Two Couriers
games.core: Two-agent pickup-and-delivery with shared-road occupancy and parcel destinations.
games.distinction: Coordinate two independently loaded agents, not one waypoint walk.
games.newDistinction: Couriers coordinate two independent loaded agents through a passing bay on a shared narrow graph; elevator routes a single FIFO carrier with capacity and door-stop costs.

games.name: Elevator Night
games.core: Capacity-constrained elevator dispatch with passenger queues and ride deadlines.
games.distinction: A shared carrier, directional boarding and passenger queue discipline.
games.newDistinction: Elevator dispatch serves dynamically released passenger queues with capacity and delivery deadlines; couriers independently route two agents and must explicitly resolve occupancy conflicts.

games.name: Supply Web
games.core: Production network investment with sequential material flow and throughput bottlenecks.
games.distinction: Buy productive capacity and route inventories, not match mechanical ratios.
games.newDistinction: Supply Web invests in a production DAG and balances raw-feed and processing bottlenecks; Assembly Belt transforms discrete moving pieces with machine settings and heat budget.

games.name: Growing Block
games.core: Urban zoning with spatial externalities, migration, upkeep and tax feedback.
games.distinction: Buildings alter habitation over successive years rather than score drafted territory.
games.newDistinction: Growing Block places persistent buildings whose local externalities govern migration and tax feedback; Marsh Balance acts on delayed population and food stocks without land placement.

games.name: Borrowed Time
games.core: Precedence-constrained parallel project scheduling with resource-specific crew assignments.
games.distinction: A dependency DAG with parallel crews and readiness constraints.
games.newDistinction: Borrowed Time schedules parallel specialist crews under a dependency DAG; Signal Cabinet instead preempts one processor and pays tool-class setup time.

games.name: Convoy Ledger
games.core: Multi-wave escort dispatch with simultaneous lane packing, voyage return times and permanent casualties.
games.distinction: Dispatch shared escorts on different voyage lengths, balancing simultaneous lane coverage against future availability.
games.newDistinction: Multiple lanes compete in a single allocation, and escorts return after different voyages; insurance selects one contract and settles correlated weather liabilities.

verification.automated: Every game: winning source-derived plan, deliberate loss and restart through keyboard and touch-only UI; 40 profile cases.
verification.independent: All20 source-reviewed; ordinary source-blind desktop wins in Workshop Shift, Quiet Majority and Cold Chain.
limitations: Chromium touch emulation is not physical-device testing.
Source-derived win plans establish reachability, not unaided difficulty.
